items.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85

sentences.en: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85.
sentences.zh: 智利战役导演帕特里西奥·古斯曼逝世，享年85岁。

sentences.en: Passionate documentary maker won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85.
sentences.zh: 充满激情的纪录片制作人因不遗余力但富有诗意的电影而赢得国际赞誉，这些电影探讨了皮诺切特政权对智利的影响帕特里西奥·古斯曼（ Patricio Guzmán ） ，这位电影制作人记录了智利1970年代血腥的政治冲突以及随后在《智利之战》和《怀旧之光》等电影中的社会和政治动荡，现年85岁。

sentences.en: According to Chilean news outlet Emol , Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
sentences.zh: 据智利新闻媒体Emol报道，古斯曼于周二在巴黎因心肺骤停去世。

sentences.en: Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president.
sentences.zh: 古斯曼在整个职业生涯中的主要关注点是1973年奥古斯托·皮诺切特（ Augusto Pinochet ）对智利当选总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德（ Salvador Allende ）发动的政变所引发的大屠杀。

sentences.en: He later told the Guardian : “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator.
sentences.zh: 他后来告诉《卫报》： “我是一名电影制片人，以独裁者的方式而闻名。

sentences.en: It has remained with me for ever.
sentences.zh: 它永远伴随着我。

sentences.en: I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist.
sentences.zh: 我不能把它抛在脑后。然而，他拒绝承认自己是一名活动家、政治电影制片人，并补充道： “我不是社会学家。

sentences.en: Neither am I a politician.
sentences.zh: 我也不是政客。

sentences.en: I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 我拍摄隐喻和诗意的电影；我通过自己的个人观看方式来解读现实。”继续阅读。

items.title: Your AI coding agent evaluation is only as good as its sandbox

sentences.en: Your AI coding agent evaluation is only as good as its sandbox.
sentences.zh: 您的AI编码代理评估仅与其沙箱一样好。

sentences.en: A passing agent evaluation can prove the wrong thing.
sentences.zh: 通过客服代表评估可能会证明是错误的。

sentences.en: The answer might be correct while the measurement behind it is invalid.
sentences.zh: 答案可能是正确的，而其背后的测量无效。

sentences.en: An AI coding agent can generate an answer from internal knowledge and related patterns.
sentences.zh: 人工智能编码代理可以从内部知识和相关模式中生成答案。

sentences.en: But it can also adapt information from the prompt or retrieve evidence from its environment.
sentences.zh: 但它也可以调整来自提示的信息或从其环境中检索证据。

sentences.en: Each route demonstrates a different capability, yet the final answer rarely reveals which route the agent took.
sentences.zh: 每条路线都展示了不同的能力，但最终答案很少能显示客服代表选择了哪条路线。

sentences.en: If your evaluation is meant to determine what a model knows, then the sandbox must prevent the agent from retrieving the knowledge under test.
sentences.zh: 如果您的评估旨在确定模型知道什么，则沙箱必须阻止代理检索被测知识。

sentences.en: Otherwise, the score represents everything available to the agent during the run.
sentences.zh: 否则，分数代表座席在运行期间可用的所有内容。

sentences.en: It can look impressive while answering a different question.
sentences.zh: 在回答不同的问题时，它看起来令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: Start with the measurement Before restricting a single tool, define what the evaluation should prove.
sentences.zh: 从测量开始在限制单个工具之前，定义评估应证明的内容。

sentences.en: Are you testing whether an agent can research an unfamiliar API or use the files in a repository?
sentences.zh: 您是否正在测试代理是否可以研究不熟悉的API或使用存储库中的文件？

sentences.en: Perhaps you want to know whether the model already understands how a specific product version behaves.
sentences.zh: 也许您想知道模型是否已经了解特定产品版本的行为方式。

items.title: Al-Qaida and IS-linked violence in Africa’s Sahel belt set to hit record levels this year

sentences.en: Al-Qaida and IS-linked violence in Africa’s Sahel belt set to hit record levels this year.
sentences.zh: 非洲萨赫勒地区与基地组织和伊斯兰国有关的暴力事件今年将达到创纪录的水平。

sentences.en: Twenty-five years after 9/11, figures compiled by conflict monitor underline how Sahel region has become centre of Islamist terror Islamist extremist violence in Africa’s Sahel region is set to reach historic highs after a series of sweeping offensives by groups linked to al-Qaida and Islamic State, according to new figures compiled by the conflict monitor Acled .
sentences.zh: 冲突监测组织ACLED汇编的新数据显示， 9/11事件发生25年后，冲突监测组织汇编的数据突显了萨赫勒地区如何成为伊斯兰恐怖的中心。在非洲萨赫勒地区，伊斯兰极端主义暴力行为在与基地组织和伊斯兰国有关的团体发动一系列全面攻势后，将达到历史最高水平。

sentences.en: As the US marks the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks launched by al-Qaida against targets in Washington and New York, the statistics underline the continued expansion of the veteran organisation in parts of Africa – in stark contrast with its relative weakness elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 在美国纪念基地组织对华盛顿和纽约目标发动9/11袭击25周年之际，统计数据突显了这个老牌组织在非洲部分地区的持续扩张--与其他地区的相对弱势形成鲜明对比。

items.title: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds

sentences.en: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，奴隶贸易财富根植于英国的金融体系。

sentences.en: Dozens of Bank of England directors and founding subscribers invested in trafficking of enslaved Africans The Bank of England and the British financial system were for centuries deeply involved in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people, according to new research on Britain’s slavery history.
sentences.zh: 根据对英国奴隶制历史的最新研究，数十名英格兰银行董事和创始用户投资于贩卖非洲奴隶。英格兰银行和英国金融体系几个世纪以来一直深深卷入数百万非洲人的奴役和跨大西洋贩卖。

sentences.en: Research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders has found that the scale of the financial system’s involvement in enslavement is greater than previously known or acknowledged.
sentences.zh: 编纂英国奴隶贩子登记册的历史学家的研究发现，金融系统参与奴役的规模比以前知道或承认的要大。

sentences.en: The Bank of England, the central bank owned by the government since nationalisation by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration in 1946, had dozens of financiers involved in its foundation who were also significant investors in the transatlantic trafficking of enslaved Africans.
sentences.zh: 英格兰银行是自1946年克莱门特·艾德礼（ Clement Attlee ）工党政府实行国有化以来由政府拥有的中央银行，其基金会中有数十名金融家，他们也是跨大西洋贩卖非洲奴隶的重要投资者。

items.title: People protecting nature and land set up self-defence units amid threat of murder

sentences.en: People protecting nature and land set up self-defence units amid threat of murder.
sentences.zh: 保护自然和土地的人们在谋杀威胁下建立了自卫队。

sentences.en: Defenders of forests and rivers killed at rate of one every three days in 2025, with 85% of deaths in Latin America Nature and land defenders were murdered at the rate of one every three days last year, prompting many communities to set up self-defence units, according to the latest annual death toll by the independent watchdog Global Witness.
sentences.zh: 根据独立监督机构Global Witness的最新年度死亡人数， 2025年，森林和河流的捍卫者以每三天一次的速度被杀害，拉丁美洲自然和土地捍卫者中85%的死亡人数以去年每三天一次的速度被杀害，这促使许多社区建立自卫队。

sentences.en: Organised crime groups or professional killers were implicated in more than a third of the 124 killings of defenders in 2025 as narco-trafficking activities overlapped with intrusions into indigenous territories and environmental crime, such as illegal logging and wildcat gold mining.
sentences.zh: 2025年， 124名维权者被杀害，其中三分之一以上与有组织犯罪集团或职业杀手有关，因为贩毒活动与入侵土著领地和环境犯罪（如非法采伐和野猫采金）重叠。

items.title: Ferocious fight among Brazil’s supreme court erupts on eve of presidential election

sentences.en: Ferocious fight among Brazil’s supreme court erupts on eve of presidential election.
sentences.zh: 巴西最高法院之间的激烈斗争在总统选举前夕爆发。

sentences.en: Scandal explodes as country’s election campaign peaks, with polls suggesting dead heat between candidates Brazil’s supreme court has been thrust into what experts consider the greatest crisis since the return of democracy in the 1980s, as two rival judges lock horns on the eve of the presidential election with unpredictable consequences for Latin America’s largest democracy.
sentences.zh: 随着巴西竞选活动的高峰，丑闻爆发，民意调查显示，巴西最高法院候选人之间的死气沉沉，被推入专家认为是自20世纪80年代民主回归以来最大的危机，因为两名竞争对手法官在总统选举前夕锁定了角，给拉丁美洲最大的民主国家带来了不可预测的后果。

sentences.en: The politically charged dispute exploded into public view on Tuesday as judges traded insults and accusations during a heated supreme court hearing that was livestreamed into millions of Brazilian homes.
sentences.zh: 周二，由于法官在最高法院举行的激烈听证会上交换了侮辱和指控，这场充满政治色彩的争端在数百万巴西家庭中直播。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod-Level Resource Managers graduated to Beta

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod-Level Resource Managers graduated to Beta.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ： Pod级资源管理器已升级到测试版。

sentences.en: With the release of Kubernetes v1.37, the Pod-Level Resource Managers feature has graduated to Beta status (disabled by default)!
sentences.zh: 随着Kubernetes v 1.37的发布， Pod级资源管理器功能已升级为Beta状态（默认禁用） ！

sentences.en: First introduced as an Alpha feature in Kubernetes v1.36 , this enhancement builds on Pod-Level Resources by equipping Kubelet's Topology Manager, CPU Manager, and Memory Manager to use Pod-level resource declarations ( .spec.resources ) directly when making hardware placement decisions.
sentences.zh: 在Kubernetes v 1.36中首次作为Alpha功能引入，此增强功能通过装备Kubelet的拓扑管理器、CPU管理器和内存管理器在做出硬件放置决策时直接使用Pod级资源声明（ .spec.resources ）来构建Pod级资源。

sentences.en: Bringing pod-level resources to node managers Before this feature, obtaining exclusive NUMA-aligned CPU cores or memory for latency-critical applications forced cluster operators into an all-or-nothing choice: assign integer resource requests to every container in the Pod, or forfeit exclusive NUMA alignment entirely.
sentences.zh: 将pod级资源带入节点管理器在此功能之前，为延迟关键型应用程序获取独家NUMA对齐的CPU内核或内存迫使集群运营商做出全有或全无的选择：将整数资源请求分配给Pod中的每个容器，或完全放弃独家NUMA对齐。

sentences.en: For modern workloads running lightweight sidecars (such as logging agents or telemetry exporters), allocating dedicated physical cores to auxiliary containers was wasteful.
Pod-Level Resource Managers solves this challenge by enabling hybrid allocation models.
The Kubelet can reserve exclusive NUMA-aligned resources for primary application containers while placing non-Guaranteed sidecars into a pod-isolated shared pool.

This ensures primary workloads get unthrottled, NUMA-local performance while sidecars benefit from running in a pod-isolated shared pool, enjoying local NUMA alignment and protection from external node interference without consuming dedicated physical cores.

What's new in Beta Graduating to Beta brings key operational and API enhancements: Graduation to Beta: Controlled by the PodLevelResourceManagers feature gate, available to opt in (disabled by default) in Kubernetes v1.37.
PodResources API Reporting: The v1 PodResources gRPC service ( PodResourcesLister ) introduces top-level cpu_ids and memory fields on PodResources responses.
Monitoring tools and device plugins can query pod-level exclusive assignments directly without double-counting container allocations.

Getting started and providing feedback For a deep dive into the technical details and configuration of this feature, check out the official documentation: Pod-level resource managers Pod-level resource managers reference To follow a step-by-step tutorial on configuring and deploying workloads: Use pod-level resources with Kubelet resource managers To learn more about how to assign resources to pods: Assign Pod-level CPU and memory resources As this feature moves through Beta toward GA, your feedback is invaluable.

items.title: Build an interview coach app with the GitHub Copilot SDK

sentences.en: Build an interview coach app with the GitHub Copilot SDK.
sentences.zh: 使用GitHub Copilot SDK构建面试导师应用。

sentences.en: An interview coach has to do more than ask questions.
sentences.zh: 面试教练要做的不仅仅是问问题。

sentences.en: It needs to read a resume, follow up on an incomplete answer, and save enough context to give useful feedback at the end.
sentences.zh: 它需要阅读简历，跟进不完整的答案，并保存足够的背景信息，以便在最后提供有用的反馈。

sentences.en: Some of that work is conversation.
sentences.zh: 其中一些工作是谈话。

sentences.en: Some of it requires calling an application service.
sentences.zh: 其中一些需要调用应用程序服务。

sentences.en: The GitHub Copilot SDK lets you use the runtime behind Copilot CLI for that work inside your own application.
sentences.zh: GitHub Copilot SDK允许您在自己的应用程序中使用Copilot CLI背后的运行时进行该工作。

sentences.en: You provide instructions and callable tools.
sentences.zh: 您提供说明和可调用的工具。

sentences.en: Copilot handles the model interaction and resulting tool calls, while your application owns the interface and business workflow.
sentences.zh: Copilot负责处理模型交互和由此产生的工具调用，而您的应用程序负责界面和业务工作流。

sentences.en: For a developer building a personal assistant or an internal workflow, this means reusing an agent runtime with capabilities specific to the application.
sentences.zh: 对于构建个人助理或内部工作流的开发人员，这意味着使用特定于应用程序的功能重用代理运行时。

sentences.en: Existing Copilot access is a practical benefit, too: the sample’s local Copilot configuration doesn’t need a separate Azure model deployment.
sentences.zh: 现有的Copilot访问也是一个实际的好处：示例的本地Copilot配置不需要单独的Azure模型部署。

sentences.en: Interview Coach demonstrates this in .NET.
sentences.zh: Interview Coach在.NET中演示了这一点。

sentences.en: The candidate sees a Blazor chat interface.
sentences.zh: 求职者看到Blazor聊天界面。
